name: Carnivorous Mold
disable: DC 42 Religion check (legendary) to neutralize the void energy that animates the mold, or DC 36 Survival check (master) to remove the mold without triggering the spores

items.name: Spore Explosion
items.text:
Trigger A living creature moves adjacent to the mold or damages the mold

---
Effect All creatures within 15 feet of the mold are exposed to the flesh-eating spores.

items.name: Flesh-Eating Spores
items.text:
The flesh-eating spores leave red rings on the skin as they dissolve the target's flesh

Saving Throw DC 44 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 4d10 void damage and Drained 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 6d10 void damage and Drained 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 8d10 void damage and Drained 3 (1 round)

text: Spores explode onto nearby creatures, leaving welts as the mold dissolves exposed flesh.
